reviews.title: No sense??
reviews.text: My friends and I played this game for a couple hours and no matter (9) how many simulations you do the one trait you can not top out on is mental health. Why??? Also, every single time the person had the same life outcome because we didn’t pay money. Bankruptcy??? Why is that. Statistically that shouldn’t happen. So I have to agree that a long time ago way in the past game developers had passion now all they have is straight greed. Money can only buy you so much happiness then you are sitting alone at night staring at a wall because you put money first. Good luck
